temporary_email.title: What is a Temporary Email Address?
temporary_email.description1: A temporary email address (also known as disposable email, throwaway email, or burner email) is a service that allows you to receive emails at a temporary address that self-destructs after a certain time period. TempEmail provides instant, anonymous temporary email addresses that protect your real inbox from spam, advertising mailings, and malicious emails.
temporary_email.description2: Our disposable email service is perfect for online registrations, downloading files, accessing free trials, or any situation where you need an email address but don't want to use your personal one. With TempEmail, you can create unlimited temporary email addresses instantly without any registration.

free.question: Is TempEmail really free?
free.answer: Yes! TempEmail is 100% free with no hidden costs, premium features, or limitations. We believe everyone deserves access to email privacy protection.

duration.question: How long does a temporary email last?
duration.answer: By default, temporary email addresses remain active for a set period. You can extend the lifetime with our time extension feature to keep it active longer.

send.question: Can I send emails from my temporary address?
send.answer: TempEmail is designed for receiving emails only. This helps maintain anonymity and prevents abuse of the service.

important.question: Is it safe to use temporary email for important registrations?
important.answer: Temporary emails are perfect for services you don't plan to use long-term. For important accounts that need password recovery, we recommend using your permanent email address.

store.question: Do you store my emails?
store.answer: We only store emails temporarily during the active session. Once your temporary email expires or is deleted, all associated data is permanently removed from our servers.

our_mission.heading: Our Mission
our_mission.text: TempEmail was created with a simple yet powerful vision: to give everyone the ability to protect their primary email address from spam, unwanted marketing, and potential security threats. In today's digital age, your email address is often the gateway to your online identity, and we believe you should have complete control over who has access to it.

what_we_do.heading: What We Do
what_we_do.text: We provide instant, disposable email addresses that you can use whenever you need to sign up for a service, download content, or interact with websites without exposing your real email address. Our service is completely free, requires no registration, and respects your privacy above all else.

Metadata.title: Privacy Policy - TempEmail | Your Data Protection & Privacy
Metadata.description: TempEmail's Privacy Policy explains how we protect your data. We don't collect personal information and automatically delete temporary emails. Complete transparency.
Metadata.ogDescription: Learn how TempEmail protects your privacy. We don't collect personal data and automatically delete all temporary emails. Your privacy is our priority.
Metadata.twitterDescription: TempEmail's commitment to your privacy: no data collection, automatic deletion, complete anonymity.

introduction.heading: 1. Introduction
introduction.text: At TempEmail, we take your privacy seriously. This Privacy Policy explains how we handle information when you use our temporary email service. Our core principle is simple: we collect minimal data and prioritize your anonymity.

dont_collect.heading: 2. Information We Don't Collect
dont_collect.text: We are committed to not collecting personal information. Specifically, we do not collect:

items.name_email: Your name, email address, or contact information
items.persistent_ids: Persistent identifiers that track you across sessions
items.browsing_history: Your browsing history outside our service

temp_process.heading: 3. Information We Temporarily Process
temp_process.text: To provide our service, we temporarily process:

items.received_emails: Emails received at those temporary addresses
items.technical_data: Technical data necessary for email delivery (sender, timestamp, subject)
items.analytics: Basic analytics to maintain service performance (anonymous usage statistics)

temp_process.note: All this data is automatically deleted when your temporary email expires or is manually deleted by you.

data_retention.heading: 4. Data Retention
data_retention.text: Temporary email addresses and their contents are stored only for the duration of the session or the extended time period you select. Once expired, all data is permanently deleted from our servers. We do not maintain backups of expired email content.

cookies_tracking.heading: 5. Cookies and Tracking
cookies_tracking.text: We use minimal cookies solely for service functionality (such as maintaining your temporary email session). We do not use tracking cookies or third-party advertising cookies. You can use our service without accepting cookies, though some features may be limited.

third_party.heading: 6. Third-Party Services
third_party.text: We do not share your data with third parties for marketing or advertising purposes. We may use essential third-party services for infrastructure (such as hosting providers), but these services are contractually bound to protect your data and not use it for their own purposes.

security.heading: 7. Security
security.text: We implement industry-standard security measures to protect the temporary data we process. This includes encryption in transit (HTTPS), secure server configurations, and regular security audits. However, no method of transmission over the internet is 100% secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.

content_warnings.heading: 8. Content Warnings
content_warnings.text: Our content safety feature analyzes incoming emails for potentially harmful content (phishing attempts, malware links, explicit content). This analysis is performed automatically and does not involve human review of your emails.

your_rights.heading: 9. Your Rights
your_rights.text: You have the right to delete your temporary email and all associated data at any time by simply closing or clearing your session. Since we don't collect personal information, there is no personal data to request, modify, or delete beyond the temporary email content itself.

child_privacy.heading: 10. Children's Privacy
child_privacy.text: Our service is not directed at children under 13. We do not knowingly collect information from children. If you believe a child has used our service, please contact us.

international_users.heading: 11. International Users
international_users.text: TempEmail is accessible globally. By using our service, you consent to the processing of data in the country where our servers are located. We comply with applicable data protection laws and regulations.

changes_policy.heading: 12. Changes to This Policy
changes_policy.text: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify users of significant changes by posting a notice on our service. Continued use after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.

contact_us.heading: 13. Contact Us
contact_us.text: If you have questions or concerns about this Privacy Policy or our privacy practices, please contact us through our support channels. We are committed to addressing your concerns promptly.
